search_text: published ZDI-25-1171 ZDI-CAN-27678 RealDefense SUPERAntiSpyware Exposed Dangerous Function Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability 2025-12-19 CVE-2025-14496 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2025-14496 7.8 AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['RealDefense'] ['SUPERAntiSpyware'] This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of RealDefense SUPERAntiSpyware. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the SAS Core Service. title: RealDefense SUPERAntiSpyware Exposed Dangerous Function Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of RealDefense SUPERAntiSpyware. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the SAS Core Service. The issue results from an exposed dangerous function. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of SYSTEM.
